verdict.rationale: Ramp ships in-product AI agents, so letting users plug external MCP servers into them is a fair question for this product. However, all MCP evidence covers the opposite role: Ramp publishing MCP servers (Ramp MCP, Developer MCP, Ramp Data MCP) for outside assistants like Claude and ChatGPT to connect to. Nothing shows Ramp or its agents consuming third-party MCP servers or their tools, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
